name: Install Fixture Covers (Spray)
intent: Cover wall-mounted outlets, switches, thermostats, and other fixtures with tape and plastic before any spray pass. The covers stay on through prime; the finish scenario removes them. Installation is the slow side of the lifecycle.
doctrine: Setup rate is per-room (15 rooms/hr = 4 minutes per room) on the assumption of ~6 fixtures per typical residential room and ~40 seconds per fixture for tape + plastic. Faster than the per-room teardown rate because installation can be done methodically without paint contamination.
